meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会扫描项目里未被引用的代码(含未用变量、导入、参数、类型和整个文件),逐条用 LSP 查引用确认,再并行派子代理删除、跑类型检查并原子提交。
howto.when: 当你提到「remove dead code」「dead code」「cleanup」等关键词,或要求清理项目里未使用的代码时触发;可用文件、目录或符号名缩小扫描范围。

say.text: 清理 src 里没被引用的导出符号
say.note: 先扫描,再用 LSP 核实后删除

say.text: 把整个项目没人用的代码删掉,分批提交
say.note: 按文件分批并行处理并原子提交

say.text: 只扫描 src/utils 目录里的死代码
say.note: 把范围缩小到指定目录

howto.what_en: Claude scans the project for unused code (locals, imports, parameters, types, whole files), confirms each candidate with LSP reference checks, then fires parallel agents to delete them, run typecheck, and make atomic commits.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “remove dead code”, “dead code”, “cleanup” and similar keywords, or ask to clean unused code in the project; a file, directory, or symbol name narrows the scan.

say_en.text: Clean up the unreferenced exports in src
Remove all unused code in this project, batch the commits
say_en.note: Groups by file and commits atomically

say_en.text: Only scan src/utils for dead code
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to that directory
